name: pwa-kit
description: What every installed web app shows about itself, for React PWAs, and the test settings that go with it: @pwa-kit/whats-new (the Update ready summary, a one-time What's new sheet after an update, the versions list for About, a Check for updates button and the version link to CHANGELOG.md on GitHub, a React package), @pwa-kit/tips (a list of one-time tips, which one to show now, dismissed for good through an injected storage), @pwa-kit/test-preset (vitest and Playwright timeouts sized for a loaded host, the MW_TIMING filter, settleAfterTeardown) and @pwa-kit/alive (useAlive(), a guard for a setState after an await).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/whats-new/tsconfig.build.json packages/tips/tsconfig.build.json packages/test-preset/tsconfig.build.json packages/alive/tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('packages/whats-new/src/styles.css', 'packages/whats-new/dist/styles.css')"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/whats-new/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/alive/tsconfig.json --noEmit
